Frontegg.title: Automation Engineer
Frontegg.fullDescription:
Frontegg is a user management platform trusted by hundreds of B2B SaaS companies. We're now building Agen — the infrastructure layer that makes applications "AI agent-ready." Think of it as Stripe for AI agent integration: we sit between AI agents (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) and enterprise APIs, providing secure, controlled access with proper authentication, authorization, and audit trails.

Agen is our next-generation product that enables:
- MCP Gateway: A secure proxy between AI agents and enterprise APIs
- Agent Registry: Track and manage which AI agents access your systems
- Policy Engine: Define what agents can and cannot do
- Consumer Marketplace: An "app store" for AI agent connectors

We're building the trust layer for the AI agent economy — and we need someone to help us ship with confidence.

We're looking for an Automation Engineer to join the Agen team. You'll own our testing infrastructure and help us move fast without breaking things. This is a hands-on role where you'll design, build, and maintain automated testing across our entire stack.

What You'll Do:

Test Automation (60%)
- Build and maintain Playwright test suites for our MCP Gateway
- Write integration tests for OAuth flows, policy enforcement, and API proxying
- Create automated E2E tests for our React-based admin portal and marketplace
- Develop contract tests for our MCP protocol implementations
- Build performance/load testing infrastructure for concurrent AI agent connections

CI/CD & Infrastructure (25%)
- Extend and maintain our GitHub Actions workflows for faster, more reliable deployments
- Set up test environments that mirror production (AWS, MongoDB, MySQL)
- Build automated smoke tests for multi-region deployments (US, EU, AU, CA, UK)
- Create alerting and monitoring for test failures and regressions

Quality Advocacy (15%)
- Partner with developers to write testable code from the start
- Review PRs with a testing mindset — catch what automated tests might miss
- Document testing patterns and best practices for the team
- Identify gaps in test coverage and prioritize what to automate next

Frontegg.title: Senior Backend Developer
Frontegg.fullDescription:
Are you a hands-on developer who loves writing code and solving complex technical challenges? Do you thrive in a team environment but can also take ownership of end-to-end feature development? If so, we want you on our team!

At Frontegg, you're not just joining a company; you're becoming part of a team that values innovation and collaboration, where your contributions truly matter. We are an innovative and dynamic startup dedicated to empowering developers by providing seamless and secure user management infrastructure, helping them achieve their goals and create amazing products.

Our customers are first-class, and with your expertise, we can continue to exceed their expectations and create success stories that inspire. If you're ready to build something eggstraordinary and take your career to the next level, Frontegg is the place for you. Let's achieve remarkable growth together and make a significant impact in the SaaS industry!

What You'll Do:
- Take full ownership of end-to-end development of key features in identity and access management.
- Work with cutting-edge AI to enhance development and security workflows.
- Drive technical excellence and help shape the architecture of our platform.
- Collaborate with a small but strong team of 4 developers and a team lead, contributing your expertise and leadership to raise the technical bar.
- Optimize and scale authentication and authorization systems with OAuth, JWT, SAML, WebAuthn, and more.
- Build and optimize services using NestJS (Node.js), TypeScript, and AWS.
- Take ownership of complex challenges, working both independently and within the team.

Who You Are:
- A highly skilled Backend Developer with 6+ years of experience, specializing in NestJS, Node.js and working in high-scale production environments.
- Deeply passionate about writing clean, efficient, and scalable code leveraging AI tools.
- A problem solver who loves working with AI and using it to boost productivity.
- Experienced in designing and implementing complex distributed systems.
- Comfortable leading technical decisions and mentoring the team.
- Hands-on with authentication, security, and identity management.
- Experience with Kafka, Redis, MySQL, OAuth, JWT, AWS is a strong advantage, and familiarity with MongoDB is a plus.

Why Join Us?
- Work in a fast-paced, highly technical environment with other passionate engineers.
- Own key features and make a significant impact on a cutting-edge product.
- Be part of a small but powerful team, where your ideas and expertise truly matter.
- Leverage AI in development to enhance your productivity and innovation.
- Work with modern technologies and stay ahead of the curve in identity management.

If you're a senior engineer looking to take technical ownership and work on a high-impact product, apply now and lead the way in shaping our identity platform!
